data.name: Ishtiaq
data.gender_notes: Ishtiaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ishtiaq means 'gift, bounty, bestowal' in various Islamic languages including Arabic, Urdu, Pashto and Bengali. It is a noble and pious name, signifying freedom, hope, and courage. The name Ishtiaq carries the meaning “gift, bounty, bestowal” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ishtiaq usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, bounty, bestowal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ishtiaq is a name that signifies the bounties and blessings bestowed upon us by Allah. It is a reminder of the spiritual gifts and blessings that we receive daily, and the importance of being grateful for them.
data.etymology: Ishtiaq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “gift, bounty, bestowal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishtiaq total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
